records.english: In hot weather you should drink plenty of water.

records.simp: 这几天高温，大家尽量别出门。
records.english: It's very hot these days, so everyone should try not to go out.

records.simp: 这种杯子不怕高温。
records.english: This kind of cup can handle high temperatures.

records.simp: 现在是高潮，海边很危险。
records.english: It's high tide now, so the beach is dangerous.

records.simp: 高潮的时候，海水会到这里。
records.english: At high tide, the sea comes up to here.

records.simp: 晚会的高潮是最后一个节目。
records.english: The high point of the party was the last act.

records.simp: 高潮来了，我们快离开海边吧。
records.english: High tide is coming; let's leave the beach quickly.

records.simp: 每个人都应该有接受高等教育的机会。
records.english: Everyone should have the chance to receive higher education.

records.simp: 他是高等数学的老师。
records.english: He's a teacher of higher mathematics.

records.simp: 人类是一种高等动物。
records.english: Humans are a kind of higher animal.

records.simp: 他在一所高等学校当老师。
records.english: He teaches at an institution of higher education.

records.simp: 她已经上高级班了。
records.english: She is already in the advanced class.

records.simp: 这是一个很高级的手机。
records.english: This is a very high-end phone.

records.simp: 这家酒店很高级。
records.english: This hotel is very upscale.

records.simp: 他学的是高级汉语。
records.english: He studies advanced Chinese.

records.simp: 我弟弟今年要参加高考。
records.english: My younger brother is taking the college entrance exam this year.

records.simp: 高考以后，他决定去北京上大学。
records.english: After the college entrance exam, he decided to go to university in Beijing.

records.simp: 她今天穿了一双红色的高跟鞋。
records.english: She is wearing a pair of red high heels today.

records.simp: 她把高跟鞋脱下来拿在手里。
records.english: She took off her high heels and carried them in her hand.

records.simp: 穿高跟鞋走路时间长了脚会疼。
records.english: If you walk in high heels for a long time, your feet will hurt.

records.simp: 我不习惯穿高跟鞋。
records.english: I'm not used to wearing high heels.

records.simp: 这双高跟鞋太高了，我走不稳。
records.english: These high heels are too high; I can't walk steadily.

records.simp: 我们打算下周坐高铁去旅游。
records.english: We plan to take the high-speed train on a trip next week.

records.simp: 现在很多人出门都喜欢坐高铁。
records.english: Nowadays many people like to travel by high-speed rail.

records.simp: 坐高铁从北京到上海只要四个多小时。
records.english: By high-speed rail it takes only a little over four hours from Beijing to Shanghai.

records.simp: 高铁又快又方便，就是票有点儿贵。
records.english: The high-speed train is fast and convenient, but the tickets are a bit expensive.

records.simp: 她穿了一件颜色鲜明的衣服。
records.english: She wore brightly colored clothes.

records.simp: 这两种看法形成了鲜明的对比。
records.english: These two views form a sharp contrast.

records.simp: 这张画的颜色很鲜明。
records.english: The colors of this painting are very bright.

records.simp: 小孩子喜欢颜色鲜艳的衣服。
records.english: Little children like brightly colored clothes.

records.simp: 春天的花颜色很鲜艳。
records.english: Spring flowers are very brightly colored.

records.simp: 妈妈生日那天，我送了她一束鲜花。
records.english: On Mom's birthday, I gave her a bunch of flowers.

records.simp: 河里有几只鸭子在游泳。
records.english: A few ducks are swimming in the river.

records.simp: 黄金的价格最近又上升了。
records.english: The price of gold has risen again recently.

records.simp: 狗在黑夜里叫个不停。
records.english: The dog kept barking in the night.

records.simp: 他白天睡觉，黑夜工作。
records.english: He sleeps by day and works at night.

records.simp: 在黑夜里开车要特别小心。
records.english: You must be extra careful driving at night.

records.simp: 黑夜过去了，天慢慢亮了。
records.english: The night passed, and the sky slowly grew light.

records.simp: 她听完以后，默默地哭了。
records.english: After hearing it, she wept silently.

records.simp: 很多人在默默地为我们工作。
records.english: Many people are quietly working for us.

records.simp: 妈妈一直默默地照顾着全家。
records.english: Mom has always quietly looked after the whole family.

records.simp: 他默默地坐在一边，什么也没说。
records.english: He sat quietly to one side and said nothing.

records.simp: 这个鼠标用起来很舒服。
records.english: This mouse is very comfortable to use.

records.simp: 我的鼠标坏了，得买个新的。
records.english: My mouse is broken; I need to buy a new one.

records.simp: 你用鼠标点一下这里。
records.english: Click here with the mouse.

records.simp: 这家超市的东西很齐全。
records.english: This supermarket has everything you need.
